# Hex's changes to Shards' renderer build

Shards is vendored here (vendor/MANIFEST.toml `[projects.shards-gpu]`) at `0342b85d9c808e3ced041a6c3ef0e9bf70438272`
for the `shards` binary a node's Shards GPU guests boot with (SHARDS_BIN), whose GPU VM process renders their Venus
on the host's driver. Hex compiles none of it. Only the files Hex's changes touch are taken, with LICENSE (MIT);
each recorded change (`vendor/patches/shards-gpu/*.patch`, applied in name order) is a row here, and
`scripts/vendor.py check shards-gpu` proves this tree is that upstream plus these, byte for byte.
`scripts/shards-gpu/build.sh` rebuilds `shards` from the same upstream commit plus these changes. The changes are
the hex/physical-gpu-0342 chain (Shards commits named in each row), less its API files, which vendor/shards carries
as the node's own client, and less its carried-image check (`f7f8b03b`): that calls shards-api, which `shards` has
only as a dev-dependency, so `cargo build --release -p shards` fails at it (reproduced on 00aad: seven unresolved
`shards_api` paths in `crates/shards/src/helpers.rs`), and nothing outside its own test calls it.

| Files | Change | Why | Patch |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `crates/abi/src/{lib,gpu}.rs` | Exact physical GPU selectors (`pci:`, `metal:`, current-boot `luid:`) and their fallible encoding in the no_std ABI the CLI, VM process and renderer share. | A node selects a GPU guest's GPU by exact physical identity, never an ordinal, and the selected set must reach the VM process unchanged (AC-T7.4.1). Shards commit `42c3193e`. | `0001-abi-share-exact-physical-gpu-selectors-through-the-no-std.patch` |
| `crates/shards/{build.rs,src/vm_run.rs}`, `crates/vmm/build.rs`, `crates/vmm/src/devices/virtio/gpu/{selection,virgl}.rs`, `crates/vmm/src/snapshot/mod.rs`, `crates/vmm/src/vm/{aarch64,mod,runtime,x86_64}.rs`, `resources/gpu/{native-identity.c,physical-linux.patch,physical-transport-linux.patch,physical-krunkit.patch,physical-transport-krunkit.patch}`, `scripts/gpu-libs` | `--gpu-device`: each Venus context of the VM bound to the exact native GPU UUIDs of its selection, through virglrenderer 1.3.0's physical-device filter and the selector transport to its render server (the patches `scripts/gpu-libs` applies to the pinned renderer) and the native identity bridge; the runtime snapshot keeps the physical GPU field. | A guest must render on its selected GPU and on no other (AC-T7.4.1). Shards commits `de0a0e6e`, `0b6a4b40`. | `0002-gpu-bind-each-selected-venus-context-to-exact-native-gpu.patch` |
| `crates/abi/src/gpu{.rs,/probe.rs}`, `crates/shards/src/{cli/mod,cli/shares,spec,vm_run}.rs`, `crates/vmm/src/devices/virtio/gpu/{selection,virgl}.rs`, `crates/vmm/src/vm/mod.rs` | Managed launch receipts and a bounded renderer capability probe (`--gpu-probe`); the context whitelist keeps its complete native GPU correspondence; managed helpers stay in their native scope, renderer queries dispatched before them. | The node launches the VM through Shards' managed API and reads these before it trusts a GPU (AC-T7.4.1). Shards commits `62f113e7`, `6b1449f3`, `6f069afe`, `28b4b4fd` (the chain to `0ce5fbcd`). | `0003-gpu-managed-launch-receipts-and-bounded-renderer-capability.patch` |
| `crates/abi/src/gpu{.rs,/probe.rs}`, `crates/vmm/src/devices/virtio/gpu/{selection,virgl}.rs`, `resources/gpu/native-identity.c` | The native report names each selected GPU and its checked device-local heap sizes. | The node checks the selected GPUs' names and memory before it offers them (AC-T7.4.1). Shards commit `070964ea`. | `0004-gpu-report-native-selected-gpu-names-and-checked-heap-sizes.patch` |
| `crates/abi/src/gpu{.rs,/probe.rs}`, `crates/shards/src/{cli/mod,spec,vm_run}.rs`, `crates/vmm/src/devices/virtio/gpu/virgl.rs`, `crates/vmm/src/vm/{aarch64,mod,runtime,x86_64}.rs` | The VM process emits its scoped private GPU report before the guest runs, arms the managed lifeline before native initialization, awaits an existing input owner before device initialization, carries only explicit managed pipes across its final Unix exec, and adopts the report writer without helper inheritance on Windows. | The protocol the node's vendored API (vendor/shards) speaks to a managed GPU VM (AC-T7.4.1). Shards commits `1ab4a163`, `bbe0e8fd`, `93687a2c`, `10f66c5c`, `1108260c`, `b128aaa5`. | `0005-vmm-emit-the-scoped-private-gpu-report-before-guest.patch` |
| `crates/vmm/src/devices/virtio/gpu/mod.rs` | Test: a context id reused after its context is destroyed takes no fence completion queued for the destroyed one. | The GPU peer's context-id reuse, held by a regression test (AC-T7.4.1). Shards commit `cb75374d`. | `0006-vmm-test-a-reused-context-id-takes-no-completion-of-the.patch` |
| `scripts/gpu-libs` | On Linux, the identity bridge's library is archived whole from its object (`ar rcsD`), as the render server's is, not copied from meson's build. | meson makes a library it does not install a thin archive on Linux (GNU ar's T), whose member names an object in gpu-libs' scratch, removed as it ends; cargo then fails bundling it into the GPU VM process ("failed to open object file"). Reproduced on 00aad (Linux x86_64, meson 1.11.2): the archive was 272 bytes of `!<thin>`. Upstream needs the same. Hex's own change. | `0007-gpu-libs-archive-the-identity-bridge-whole-on-linux.patch` |
